PRO's multiple clipped turns are an execution cost, but the arguments came through before the clips. CON's closing crystallized the consent-infrastructure question cleanly, and that remains the debate's most unresolved tension, but it was not enough to overcome PRO's stronger moral grounding and uncontested opt-out-inadequacy argument.
